resources.string: Chooses the resolution to suit the device and image processing.
Image filters and scaling at display resolution.
Image filters and scaling at the app interface resolution.
Chooses video output to suit the decoder, device and image processing.
Uses Android output, or Vulkan when image processing needs it and support is available.
Prefers the direct Android video surface.
Prefers OpenGL for video output and supported image filters.
Prefers Vulkan for video output and supported image filters.
Uses Android video output, with OpenGL ES when needed.
Chooses Gamma 2.2 when HDR output is detected; otherwise BT.1886.
Uses the fixed Gamma 2.2 curve for SDR output, regardless of the detected display mode.
Uses the fixed BT.1886 curve for SDR output, regardless of the detected display mode.
Adjusts interface effects to your device.
Uses the standard interface effects.
Enables extra shadows and optional accent animations for focused items.
Reduces interface effects and disables navigation sounds.
Adjusts video processing to your device.
Allows image filters without motion smoothing.
Allows demanding video processing and motion smoothing.
Uses low-power defaults for video processing.
Soft sheen lit from above. Motion: a broad, gentle shimmer glides across.
Bright glass rim along the top edge. Motion: a glint runs along the upper edge.
Soft halo around the element. Motion: the halo breathes.
Iridescence from your accent color. Motion: its hues travel around the border.
Rich, matte glaze. Motion: a soft lamp reflection wanders along the top.
Brushed metal with a hard highlight line. Motion: a quick, narrow flash.
Fixed crystal planes. Motion: corners and planes sparkle one after another.
Solid color without a gradient. Motion: the color breathes gently.
Shows animated patterns that react to music.
Shows the frequency spectrum of the audio.
Disables audio visualization.
Uses passthrough when the audio device supports it.
The app decodes the audio before output.
Requests passthrough even without reported format support.
Matches the output resolution and refresh rate to the video.
Uses the highest allowed display resolution with a matching refresh rate.
Uses the system display mode.
Uses the system display mode as the starting point for automatic adjustment.
Uses the selected display mode during playback.
Uses the selected resolution; the refresh rate may adjust automatically.
Does not automatically adjust the display mode to the video.
Also adjusts the mode during playback and restores it at the end.
Adjusts the mode at playback start and restores it at the end.
Adjusts the mode at playback start without restoring it at the end.
